adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a raw-HTML rendering path where imported content bypasses Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization. `Post#cook` now returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), and `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` using `raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). Feed polling pulls `i.content` and runs `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) without any sanitization/whitelist, and the embed view renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). This combination makes stored, unfiltered HTML from a feed/remote source renderable from the Discourse origin, enabling stored XSS if the source is malicious/compromised.
